name: tracetoon
description: Tracetoon: PR descriptions written from your coding agents’ session logs.

plugins.name: tracetoon
plugins.description: Creates your PR with a description written from your Claude Code session logs, and an optional one-off comic. Every claim is checked against what your agent actually did before the PR is posted. On 61 real pull requests from 12 repositories, AI judges who agreed on a winner preferred the descriptions from Tracetoon's evidence graph to its earlier multi-agent workflow 60 to 21 on Claude Code, at 43% lower cost per PR.
